title: Feature request: Change which input devices are effected by Push to talk
line: You can now choose which microphones the Push to Talk shortcut mutes and unmutes in Sound settings → Configure Volume Controls.
explanation: Push to talk reused the global microphone mute, which mutes every input device when the key is released, so sources the user wanted to keep live (capture cards, loopback/virtual inputs) were muted too. Adjusting or unmuting such a source while push to talk was idle also counted as breaking the global mute and unmuted the real microphone. A new PushToTalkExcludedSources setting lists sources push to talk leaves alone; the Volume Controls page shows a "Push to talk controls:" checkbox per microphone (all checked by default, so behaviour is unchanged until the user unticks one), and the kded skips unticked sources both when pushing to talk and when reacting to their volume, mute or port changes.

commits.message:
kded: let users choose which microphones push to talk controls

Push to talk always muted and unmuted every input device, so recording
from a capture card or loopback source while using it was not possible.
The Volume Controls page now lists the microphones to pick from.

BUG: 521697

media.caption: Master: after pressing and releasing push to talk, both the headset microphone and the capture card are muted
With the fix and Capture Card unticked: releasing push to talk mutes only the headset microphone, the capture card stays live
Master: Volume Controls page has no way to choose the devices push to talk affects
With the fix: new "Push to talk controls:" list with one checkbox per microphone

review.text: Stores an exclusion list so default behaviour is unchanged and new devices are included automatically; the kded skips excluded sources in both pushToTalk() and the source-change handler, which is the actual cause of the capture card being muted/unmuting the mic. The KCM list on the existing Volume Controls page is consistent with the page, and the verification shows the excluded source staying live.
